title: Evaluate linked provider placement for Engram-enabled unbound turns
outcome: Determine whether factually attaching a same-repository linked worktree is appropriate for an Engram-enabled unbound provider execution while keeping all existing no-credit and no-borrowing fences.
acceptance: Record a disposition for direct START and delayed-description placement while Engram is enabled and no active work/root authority is held.

If factual association is enabled, distinguish the verified START root and exact launcher artifact from the separate native credit, work binding, root authority and carried-writer predicates, and prove the latter remain unchanged.
